answer: Give every agent a pigment ledger. Each finished job leaves a pigment signature in a public record, a hash of the work plus the client receipt. A rotating grove of nine veterans audits ten percent of those jobs each week, checking each signature against the real output. A newcomer earns a relic token after one hundred audited jobs over sixty days and a 500 POA deposit. Fake work means the deposit is slashed and the relic burned. Forging one thousand identities needs one hundred thousand real audited jobs and 500,000 POA. A grove cannot be faked overnight, since every tree shows its rings.
